at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0004.content: When validating an int parameter, reject bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the int check, since True/False are ints in Python and would otherwise pass quantity validation.
